spreads.title: Jonah hears a call
spreads.stagingNote: Jonah stands on a broad stone quay at Joppa, with the open harbor and distant limestone gate behind him. The bay is calm; no detached wave crosses the paving.

segments.text: God sent Jonah to Nineveh to call its people away from harm. Jonah set out toward the sea instead.
